statements.statement: The member presented with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The member has known atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery (I25.10)
The member has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
The provider determined that correlating symptoms with potential arrhythmic events required long-term continuous electrocardiogram monitoring
CPT 93247, a long-term continuous ECG monitoring study, was submitted for claim
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial is based on required precertification or prior authorization not being obtained or submitted prior to the service date
